chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Ludwig innovations, wood drums and bass drum size
summary: Ludwig kept innovating; Saunders uses a 26-inch bass drum and prefers a round, soft beater.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
